Package teilchen.constraint

Class TriangleMeshCollider

java.lang.Object
teilchen.constraint.Collider
teilchen.constraint.TriangleMeshCollider
All Implemented Interfaces:
Constraint
public class TriangleMeshCollider extends Collider
keeps particles from passing through a mesh of triangles. triangles are two-sided and stored in a uniform spatial hash grid so that each particle is only tested against triangles near its path.

vertices are copied when the collider is created. if the mesh changes call update(float[]) ( or update() for colliders created from an indexed vertex array, which is referenced ).

  • Field Details

    • AUTO_ORIENT

      public boolean AUTO_ORIENT
      if true triangle winding is made consistent across shared edges when the mesh is built. particles that are exactly on the surface count as being on the front side, so consistent winding gives consistent behavior. set before calling update.
